title: DeskAgentRequestEnvelope
description: Standard request envelope for Desk Agent R1 cross-module RPC and tools dispatch

request_id.description: Unique idempotency identifier generated by the caller. Retries must retain the same request_id.

operation.description: Target operation in domain.action format (e.g., ha.execute, codex.submit)

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which the request must be discarded without execution

session_id.description: Associated session or dialogue turn identifier

client_id.description: Identifier of the requesting subsystem (e.g., tclaw-firmware, edge-application, win-companion)
